Anita (PM): OK team quick triage  for the two-week mini-iteration let's split the post-launch backlog into SHIP / DEFER / TRY. want ~3 SHIP items, low-risk & high-impact.
Marco (Eng): +1. propose criteria: customer-facing error or SLA hit, <=2d estimate, contained to one service, and ideally reduces unit cost.
Leah (Design): onboarding tooltip flow shows dropout at step 2; small copy + layout tweak ~4-6h could move the needle.
Carlos (SRE): we saw a 5% p99 spike on /gen last night around 03:12 UTC. looks like a batching regression; filed BUG-2007.
Marco (Eng): quick estimates: BUG-2007 (batching regression) 1.5d to diagnose + patch, FEAT-401 (tooltip tweak) 6h, CHORE-900 (runtime deps) 2.5d, PERF-512 (cache TTL tweak) 4h.
Anita (PM): initial proposal: SHIP = BUG-2007, FEAT-401; TRY = PERF-512 (opt-in route-level TTL change); DEFER = CHORE-900 (bigger runtime upgrade).
Leah (Design): FEAT-401 owner = Leah. will include accessibility checks and screenshots.
Marco (Eng): BUG-2007 -> Marco. I'll add deterministic regression tests and a smoke plan.
Carlos (SRE): I'll own canary and monitoring for BUG-2007. alert thresholds: error-rate > 0.5% or p99 up > 10%.
orch-bot: Canary scheduled: `canary/bug2007-batchfix` at 1777001000 (UTC).
Marco (Eng): repro command I used locally:
``
python -m tools/load_test --route /gen --concurrency 20 --tokens 512
```
Marco (Eng): root cause hint: when batch_size auto-falls back to 64 under concurrency, latency spikes. lowering to 32 recovered p99 in my run.
Carlos (SRE): good to know. I'll prepare dashboard (p50/p95/p99 + error-rate) and a short rollback playbook: revert to tag `revert/r2026-batch` and set BATCH_SIZE=32.
Anita (PM): action items: 1) update grooming board with SHIP/DEFER/TRY labels, 2) tag owners and estimates in each ticket, 3) confirm 2h canary window tomorrow.
Leah (Design): I'll upload before/after screenshots and link funnel delta in the FEAT-401 ticket.
Marco (Eng): will push a small branch, add tests, and request review.
Anita (PM): syncing in 20m to lock sprint choices. thanks everyone :rocket:
